# Art in Context — image credits

This edition includes 42 artist portraits and 28 actual artwork images. It does not present original teaching graphics as the featured artists’ work. The source file pages record the licences used; some photographs rely on a documented public-art panorama exception for the underlying work, which is not claimed to be copyright-free. Those cases are identified below.

All images are stored locally. Source and licence addresses in the student interface are plain text, without outgoing links. Source metadata is preserved in IMAGE-CREDITS.json.

## Salvador Dalí — work image

File: `assets/extra/09-homage-newton.webp`  
Title: Homage to Newton  
Credit: Karl Baron from Lund, Sweden. · CC BY 2.0  
Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:SalvadorDali-HomagetoNewton-1985-Singapore-20071231.jpg  
Licence: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0  
Changes: Resized and converted to WebP; content not cropped or altered.

Underlying-work rights: Photograph by Karl Baron, CC BY 2.0. Underlying sculpture is permanently displayed at UOB Plaza. Singapore Copyright Act 2021 s265 permits making and publishing photographs of permanent sculptures in public places or premises open to the public; artwork itself is not claimed public domain. See https://sso.agc.gov.sg/Act/CA2021?ProvIds=pr265- .

Content note for teacher preview: Nonsexual figurative nude sculpture; suitable for an art-history discussion, with teacher preview.
